%%| column: page
%% The overview: one file, included by index.qmd and architecture.qmd, never copied.
%% It changes with the Architecture page's diagrams (CLAUDE.md, Docs must be true).
flowchart TB
  classDef planned stroke-dasharray: 5 5

  subgraph mine["my Mac and phone"]
    harness["pi, opencode, Hermes<br/>in a terminal or Orca"]
    browser["web UI<br/>in a browser or as an app"]
  end

  later["my apps · Phase 3<br/>family and guests · Phase 6"]:::planned
  claude["Claude Code and<br/>Claude Desktop<br/>wherever they run"]
  anthropic(("Anthropic"))

  subgraph spark["brightroar · the DGX Spark"]
    owui["Open WebUI<br/>with SearXNG for search"]
    agent["pi as agent<br/>in tmux"]
    litellm["LiteLLM, a key per app · Phase 3<br/>ahead of the front, in its place,<br/>or not at all"]:::planned
    front["the front<br/>checks each key"]
    gate["spark-gate<br/>decides every load"]
    swap["llama-swap<br/>starts the model<br/>the gate admits"]
    guard["fit check, memory brake<br/>a model loads only if it fits"]
    engines["llama.cpp, whisper.cpp<br/>models for chat, coding,<br/>embeddings, speech"]
    vllm["vLLM<br/>Phase 4"]:::planned
    fast["the fast coder on SGLang<br/>Phase 4a"]:::planned
    flash["Flash-Next on llama.cpp<br/>Phase 4a"]:::planned
  end

  nas["Synology<br/>alerts, through ntfy · Phase 5<br/>backups · Phase 5"]:::planned

  harness -- "SSH tunnel, over Tailscale<br/>or the LAN" --> front
  browser -- "HTTPS over Tailscale" --> owui
  later -.-> litellm
  claude -- "never through the Spark" --> anthropic
  owui --> front
  agent --> front
  front --> swap
  front -- "asks before a load" --> gate
  gate -- "loads, unloads" --> swap
  litellm -. "through the front or in its place,<br/>if Phase 3 adds it" .-> swap
  swap --> guard
  gate --> guard
  guard --> engines
  guard -.-> vllm
  guard -.-> fast
  guard -.-> flash
  gate -. "alerts, to ntfy" .-> nas
